content.text: Andhra Pradesh Ayush Counselling 2025 is conducted for admission into AYUSH courses- BAMS/BNYS/BUMS/BSMS/BHMS. Dr NTR University of Health Sciences, Vijayawada (DRNTRUHS) is the authority handling the Ayush Counselling process in Andhra Pradesh. sections.heading: Andhra Pradesh Ayush Counselling Overview

content.text: Admission to all the Ayurveda, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha & Homeopathy courses is done through the AP Ayush counselling, which is handled by the Dr NTR University of Health Sciences . The Andhra Pradesh Ayush Counselling official website is https://drntr.uhsap.in/ , visit the website to find all the official information and notifications regarding the counselling. The candidates with a higher secondary science stream who studied Physics, Chemistry, and Biology subjects and also qualified for the NEET examination can participate in the counselling.

According to the National Commission for Indian System of Medicine (NCISM) , there are 2 Unani colleges, 7 BHMS colleges, 3 BNYS colleges, and 3 BAMS colleges in Andhra Pradesh . 85% of the seats are reserved for state quota under the Andhra Pradesh Ayush Counselling, generally offered for domicile students. And the remaining 15% are the All India quota seats, where students from other states can apply. The counselling for AIQ seats is conducted by the AACCC .

Visit the official website of NTRUHS at https://drntr.uhsap.in/ and register using your mobile number and email ID for AP Ayush registration.
Provide the necessary personal information and upload the relevant documents.
Complete the registration successfully by paying the fees as prescribed.

After successful registration with the counselling authority, the candidates can participate in the Choice Filling, where they can choose their preferences of colleges from the list of available colleges in the state.

The candidates are given a deadline to complete the choice filling and lock their choices. If the choices are not locked, their allotment cannot be processed, and they will not be allotted to any colleges.
On completion of the choice filling round, Allotment results will be published on the official website of NTRUHS.
The Seat Allotment is processed in multiple rounds. The candidates are allotted seats based on their NEET scores, preference, and after considering the reservation.
Log in with your credentials on the official website to check the allotment status.

Generally, there are 3 to 4 rounds of counselling. If allotted a college in the first round, they can move to the next steps; if not allotted during the first round, they may participate in the further rounds.
The candidates allotted seats must report to the designated centers to attend the document verification process.
Carry all the original documents and certificates, and fetch the verification slip after verifying them.
The candidates must report to the allotted college within the stipulated time with all of the necessary documents.
Complete the admission formalities and make payment of the college fees within the period provided by the college to confirm the seats.
